name: Jesus
note: The risen Lord whose story Luke's Gospel tells.

name: Simon Peter
note: A fisherman, the leader of the apostles in the early chapters.

name: John
note: An apostle and a fisherman, with Peter at the temple.

name: The eleven
note: The apostles after Judas' death.

name: The twelve
note: The apostles, with Matthias.

name: The apostles
note: The twelve, sent by Jesus.

name: Mary
note: The mother of Jesus.

name: Jesus' brothers
note: They did not believe in him earlier but are among the believers now.

name: Judas Iscariot
note: The apostle who betrayed Jesus.

name: Matthias
note: Chosen to take Judas' place.

name: Two men in white
note: They appear at the ascension.

name: The believers
note: The first followers of Jesus in Jerusalem.

name: The pilgrims
note: Jews from many nations in Jerusalem for Pentecost.

name: The lame man
note: Healed at the Beautiful Gate.

name: The crowds
note: Ordinary people in Jerusalem.

name: Annas
note: A former high priest, still very influential.

name: Caiaphas
note: High priest from about AD 18 to 36.

name: The Sadducees
note: A priestly party that denied resurrection.

name: The council
note: The Sanhedrin.

name: Barnabas
note: A Levite from Cyprus, named Joseph, nicknamed "Son of Encouragement."

name: Ananias and Sapphira
note: A husband and wife who lied about a gift.

name: The high priest
note: The head of the temple and the council.

name: Gamaliel
note: A respected Pharisee and teacher of the law.

name: The Hellenist widows
note: Greek-speaking widows who were neglected.

name: Stephen
note: One of the seven; the first martyr.

name: Philip
note: One of the seven, later called the evangelist.

name: Nicolaus
note: A proselyte of Antioch, one of the seven.

name: The Synagogue of the Freedmen
note: A group of Jews from North Africa and Asia Minor who argued with Stephen.

name: Saul
note: A young man from Tarsus who approves of Stephen's death; later called Paul.
